title: 1 Hour Private Vineyard Dome Experience in Niagara-on-the-Lake
includes: Transportation to/from the meeting point (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy this one of a kind tasting experience in our brand new Vineyard Dome, while overlooking the scenic vineyards, Lake Ontario and views of the Toronto skyline. Being Niagara's only Lakefront winery, we’re proud to introduce this 60 minute Private Tasting in a 'luxury style' dome is located on a raised outdoor platform. Your experience includes a private structured tasting of our Family Reserve Series wines accompanied by locally sourced charcuterie and breads... and of course some 'chill time' to relax and take in the view.
